input_policy: Read the two supplied immutable CIFs directly. CCDC record numbers are provenance only; CCDC database retrieval is not required or scored. Verify archive ID, formula, elements, occupancy and cell; do not edit the raw CIFs. Record component selection, atom mapping and deterministic octyl-to-methyl transformation in the submission. Do not use the paper or SI as a computational input.
